eyebrow: What an Update Set actually captures
code:
Update Set:                      Git repository:
- a point-in-time snapshot        - full file history over time
- "what changed in this batch"   - who changed which exact line, and when
- no branching, no PR review      - branches, diffs, pull-request review
caption: Update Sets capture and promote. They were never built to be version control.

code:
Studio (scoped application)
        |
        |  connected via Source Control Integration
        v
External Git repository (GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket)
        |
        |  push: instance -> repo
        |  pull: repo -> instance
        v
Application code tracked like any other software project
caption: A scoped application's files, connected to a real external Git repository.
